rule: An entry takes effect only when the Platform Owner merges the reviewed pull request its reference names. No entry names who approved it: the merge is the approval.

checks.detail: The evidence contract is version 2, the version this server reads for a publication.
Every field is one the contract names, within its bounds: no input, output or payload.
The dossier digest is the digest of its content, and its execution and publication ids derive from what it records.
The run trace is an unbroken hash chain, and the run id is its head.
The execution log is an unbroken hash chain of its own, and every step of it commits to the run trace.
Every state, agent, handoff, decision and outcome shown is the one the chains record.
Every decision was an eligible role’s and never the submitter’s, and no medical action was approved.
Synthetic LAB data only: lab references, no address or real id, no health field.
Every agent and tool it names is registered on this server.

A provenance record names the reviewed definition and the commit on main that produced it, and describes this dossier. The publication gate must replay that definition and reproduce this dossier exactly before it is merged.
The approval record lists it once, with this digest, for a reviewed pull request.
